description:
We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer with deep expertise in healthcare data to join a pioneering team building data products that enable world\-leading research. Whether your experience comes from academia, healthcare, biotech, or a fast\-growing health\-tech startup, you'll bring a strong understanding of healthcare data standards such as OMOP or FHIR, alongside the technical leadership required to be a Senior Engineer.


In this role, you'll design and build scalable data pipelines that transform complex health records into trusted, research\-ready datasets used by scientists and researchers tackling challenges with global significance. You'll work at the intersection of engineering, data science and epidemiology, helping to establish best practices, shape technical direction and create reusable, high\-quality data products that can operate at industrial scale.


If you're a senior engineer who enjoys solving complex data challenges, influencing how healthcare data is curated and delivered, and making a meaningful impact on research that improves lives, we'd love to hear from you.


Our Future Health will be the UK’s largest ever health research programme, bringing people together to develop new ways to detect, prevent, and treat diseases. Diseases like cancer, dementia, diabetes, and heart disease affect the lives of many people in our communities. Our goal is to create a world\-leading resource for health research, to improve our understanding and spot the patterns of how and why common diseases start, so treatments can begin sooner and be more effective.


Our plan is to bring together 5 million volunteers from right across the UK who will be asked to contribute information to help build one of the most detailed pictures we have ever had of people’s health. Researchers will be able to use this information to make new discoveries about human health and diseases. So future generations can live in good health for longer.

**What you'll be doing:**

* Designing and building scalable data pipelines that ingest healthcare data from multiple providers into trusted research environments and data platforms.
* Developing and maintaining data transformation logic in Python to create high\-quality, curated and research\-ready datasets.
* Contributing to complex, shared codebases while following engineering best practices including code reviews, testing and clean coding standards.
* Collaborating with data scientists, epidemiologists, software engineers and product teams to understand requirements and deliver impactful data solutions.
* Processing large\-scale healthcare datasets and implementing robust data quality, validation and governance controls.
* Transforming and harmonising healthcare data into common data models such as OMOP and FHIR to support research and analytical use cases.
* Creating reusable, scalable and maintainable data products that enable efficient consumption by multiple stakeholders.
* Communicating effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders to translate complex requirements into practical engineering solutions.
* Producing clear and comprehensive technical documentation covering data pipelines, transformation logic, architecture and operational processes.
* Supporting the design, scoping and implementation of data flows across the wider healthcare data ecosystem.
* Leveraging cloud and big data technologies, including Azure, Databricks, Spark and Data Lakes, to deliver high\-performing data solutions.
* Adopting and promoting data engineering best practices, healthcare data standards and continuous improvement across the team.
* Keeping abreast of emerging trends, technologies and standards within healthcare, research and data engineering to drive innovation and excellence.

  

**Requirements**  

To succeed in tis role you will need to demonstrate some of the following:

* Proven Data Engineering experience within complex, large\-scale data environments.
* Experience designing, building and maintaining scalable, reliable data pipelines that process large volumes of data from multiple sources.
* Experience working with healthcare data across academia, healthcare, life sciences, health technology or related sectors.
* Knowledge of healthcare data standards and common data models, including OMOP and/or FHIR.
* Experience transforming and remodelling data between different Common Data Models (CDMs).
* Understanding of healthcare terminologies and ontologies, including SNOMED CT, ICD\-10 and Read Codes.
* Experience contributing to shared codebases and developing reusable, maintainable data solutions.
* Proficiency in Python and software engineering best practices.
* Good command\-line and Unix/Linux skills.
* Experience working with cloud platforms, ideally Microsoft Azure.
* Experience using technologies such as Spark, Databricks and data lake architectures.
* Knowledge of data storage and transformation formats such as Apache Parquet and Delta Lake.
* Experience with containerisation and orchestration technologies, including Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience using Git/GitHub and working within collaborative development environments.
* Experience working within Agile delivery teams.

  

**Benefits**  

* Competitive base salary from £74,000 per annum
* Generous Pension Scheme – We invest in your future with employer contributions of up to 12%
* 30 Days Holiday pro rata \+ Bank Holidays – Enjoy a generous holiday allowance with the flexibility to take bank holidays when it suits you

* EV Scheme – Save up to 40% on a brand new electric vehicle all\-inclusive package through salary sacrifice

Are you ready to harness AI to accelerate cell therapy trials and improve outcomes for people facing cancer and immune\-mediated disease? AstraZeneca is building a world\-class capability in AI for Clinical Development to transform how we design, run and analyze trials across our pipeline. As Director, Cell Therapy AI Business Partner, you will be the senior scientific and business link between our enterprise cell therapy leaders and the AI for Clinical Development team, turning unmet needs into a clear, high\-value portfolio of AI solutions that deliver measurable impact.


Based in Cambridge, UK, you will sit between clinical and scientific experts in cell therapy and AI scientists and engineers. You will frame rigorous clinical questions, shape them into tractable AI problems, guide development and validation, and drive adoption so solutions are trusted at the point of decision. In a fast\-moving field, you will bring clarity, build credibility with senior stakeholders, demonstrate value early and scale what works.


Do you thrive where cutting\-edge science meets machine intelligence and enjoy leading through ambiguity to deliver evidence that changes decisions? This is your chance to shape the roadmap for AI in cell therapy clinical development across a diverse enterprise portfolio.


**Accountabilities:**


Demand shaping, prioritization, and value: Provide scientific leadership to identify and scope the highest\-value clinical development questions in cell therapy that AI can address; translate function needs into a prioritized pipeline; build business cases with success metrics; track adoption and benefits after delivery; champion change so solutions are used in practice; guide buy\-versus\-build and vendor evaluations for cell therapy use cases.


Strategy and forward look: Align cell therapy\-focused AI efforts with the broader AI for Clinical Development portfolio; anticipate scientific and clinical nuances unique to cell therapy that shape design and validation; monitor the state of the art and co\-create the forward roadmap; identify methodological requirements, evidence gaps and advocacy opportunities to safely advance clinical AI.


Business partnering and relationship management: Serve as the primary, trusted partner between AI for Clinical Development and the enterprise cell therapy organization spanning hematology, oncology, autoimmune and rare diseases; act as a core member of cell therapy project teams while coordinating with AI delivery functions; develop a deep understanding of priorities, workflows and decision points; represent the voice of cell therapy to AI teams and the capabilities and constraints of AI to clinical teams; build credibility with senior leaders and provide structured decision support when priorities compete.


Data, standards, and validation: Bring the clinical and scientific context—endpoints, reference standards and constraints—that AI teams need; work side by side with AI scientists and engineers from scoping through development, evaluation and clinical validation; define and guide clinical and scientific validation against the right reference standards to meet the evidentiary bar required in clinical development.


**Essential Skills/Experience:**


* Master’s degree in AI/ML with experience applying these methods to clinical and/or biomedical data. We welcome strong candidates from adjacent computational or scientific fields whose expertise maps to the role.
* 5\+ years experience developing AI/ML for clinical, biomedical, healthcare, or other life\-sciences problems.
* Applicable experience in drug development, clinical development, or the life sciences, sufficient to engage credibly with clinical and scientific teams.
* Experience with the clinical and scientific validation of AI, predictive, or digital tools in a clinical or healthcare context.
* Familiarity with generative AI and agentic systems applied to clinical development or the life sciences.

 We are looking for a Data Science Lead to build and lead Alto's data science capability from the ground up. * Define and own Alto's data science roadmap, prioritising use cases based on measurable ROI and commercial impact

* Partner with Platform and Data Engineering to productionise models on Mission Control, defining data quality and feature requirements for reliable modelling
* Develop segmentation and scoring frameworks that Customer Operations and Commercial teams can act on directly

title: Behavioral Science Specialist - Supervising Associate
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 The Behavioral Scientist will apply advanced behavioral science, psychometrics, and quantitative and qualitative research methods to design, analyze, and interpret complex talent and employee experience data. The role is responsible for developing scientifically rigorous insights that inform strategic talent decisions, workforce interventions, and organizational effectiveness initiatives. This position requires deep expertise in organizational research methodology, predictive and prescriptive modeling, and statistical programming. The Behavioral Scientist partners closely with Talent Insights and Analytics, Employee Listening, and senior Talent stakeholders to translate research findings into practical, evidence‑based recommendations. The role contributes to advancing the firm’s analytical maturity by embedding strong scientific standards, scalable methodologies, and advanced modeling approaches into talent analytics and decision‑making.
   

  

**Essential Functions Of The Job**
* Design and conduct applied organizational research using robust quantitative methodologies, including experimental, quasi‑experimental, and longitudinal designs.
* Lead advanced analysis of employee listening, experience, and talent data using statistical programming languages (SQL, R, and/or Python).
* Apply advanced predictive and prescriptive modeling techniques (e.g., regression, multilevel models, machine learning, optimization approaches) to address complex talent and workforce questions.
* Develop and validate psychometric models, including scale development, factor analysis, reliability and validity assessment, and measurement invariance testing.
* Integrate multiple data sources (survey, experience, talent, and operational data) to generate holistic and scientifically defensible insights.
* Translate complex analytical and research outputs into clear narratives, recommendations, and decision‑support materials for senior Talent and business stakeholders.
* Support the design and evaluation of talent interventions by defining success metrics, analytic approaches, and evidence thresholds.
* Contribute to the development of standardized research and analytics frameworks, ensuring consistency, rigor, and scalability across Talent Insights and Analytics.
* Partner with Talent IT, data engineering teams, and external vendors to ensure appropriate data structures, access, and analytical readiness.
* Monitor emerging research, analytical techniques, and best practices in behavioral science, psychometrics, and people analytics to continuously enhance internal capabilities


 Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities
   

  

* Apply expert judgment in selecting appropriate research designs, statistical methods, and modeling approaches based on business context and data constraints.
* Make recommendations on analytic strategies, modeling techniques, and interpretation standards to ensure scientific rigor and decision relevance.
* Evaluate the strength of evidence supporting findings and clearly communicate limitations, assumptions, and confidence levels.
* Support decisions related to prioritization, design, and continuous improvement of Talent Insights and Analytics research and modeling initiatives.
* Influence stakeholder decision‑making by synthesizing data, research findings, and behavioral science principles into actionable guidance


 Supervision Responsibilities
   

  

* Act as a subject matter expert and thought partner within Talent Insights and Analytics.
* Provide informal coaching and technical guidance to colleagues on research design, analytics, and interpretation.
* Collaborate closely with cross‑functional teams to ensure analytical quality, consistency, and impact.
* Build trusted relationships through credibility, rigor, and constructive challenge.
* Ability to develop people, skills in coaching, mentoring, and learning on the job
* Effectiveness in building trust, respect, and cooperation among teams


**Knowledge And Skills Requirements**
* Deep expertise in behavioral science, with strong grounding in Industrial and Organizational Psychology or a closely related discipline.
* Advanced knowledge of organizational research methodology, including experimental design, causal inference, and applied statistical modeling.
* Strong command of psychometrics, including scale construction, validation, and measurement theory.
* Advanced analytical skills using SQL, R, and/or Python for data extraction, manipulation, modeling, and analysis.
* Demonstrated expertise in predictive and prescriptive analytics, including advanced statistical and machine learning techniques.
* Strong data storytelling and visualization skills to communicate complex findings effectively to non‑technical audiences.
* Strong business acumen and ability to contextualize research insights within broader talent and organizational strategies.
* Ability to operate independently on complex analytical problems while collaborating effectively in cross‑functional, global teams.
* High tolerance for ambiguity and ability to apply scientific rigor in fast‑paced, evolving environments.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a global and culturally aware mindset


**Other Requirements**
* Due to the global nature of the role, flexibility to work alternative hours may be required.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills are required.


**Job Requirements**
 Education:
   

  

* Ph.D. strongly preferred in Industrial and Organizational Psychology, Organizational Psychology, Behavioural Science, Statistics, or a closely related quantitative discipline.
* Master’s degree with significant applied research experience may be considered.


 Certification Requirements:
   

  

 Professional certifications or active engagement in relevant professional or academic communities preferred but not required.
   

  

 Experience:
   

  

* Demonstrated experience conducting applied organizational research in a business, consulting, or applied research environment.
* Experience applying advanced statistical, predictive, and prescriptive modeling techniques to real‑world organizational problems.
* Hands‑on experience with psychometric analysis and measurement development in organizational contexts.
* Experience working with large‑scale employee listening or experience datasets.
* Proven ability to translate complex research findings into practical, business‑relevant insights.
* Experience collaborating with Talent, HR, or People teams to shape evidence‑based decisions.
* Experience working in global, matrixed, and fast‑paced environments.
* Experience partnering with data engineering teams or external vendors to enable advanced analytics.

title: PBWM Data Analyst

You will work closely with stakeholders across the business to analyse large datasets, identify trends and patterns, and ensure data is effectively mapped and translated into meaningful insights that drive business value.
   

  

 The role will include analysing and interpreting large and complex datasets, working with stakeholders to gather requirements and map data, supporting data modelling and the delivery of insight\-driven solutions.
   

  

 To be successful as a Data Analyst, you should have experience with:
   

  

  

* Data mapping and data modelling with the ability to translate business requirements into structured data solutions leveraging diverse and complex datasets
* Data analysis including strong SQL skills and/or other programming languages (e.g. Python, R) including advanced MS Excel
* Knowledge of Financial Services Data Domains and journeys

* Experience with data governance including data quality controls
* Stakeholder management experience including requirements elicitation with good communication skills to present complex topics to senior audiences

 We’re Standard Life, a retirement specialist focused entirely on retirement savings and income. We champion the belief that everyone’s journey to and through retirement can be better, and for more than 200 years, we’ve been helping our customers plan and prepare for their financial futures.

We offer our colleagues flexibility, trust and benefits that work for whatever life brings. In return we expect curiosity, connection, accountability and high standards. We make room for what matters \- so you can bring your best, every day.
   

  

**The role**
 The Data Solutions Specialist – Annuities is a technically focused role responsible for designing, building, and enhancing data solutions that support the onboarding and ongoing servicing of Bulk Purchase Annuity (BPA) schemes.
   

  

 Working within the BPA Data team and in close partnership with Transformation, the role will develop scalable data models, tooling, and automation to improve the efficiency, control, and accuracy of pensions data processes.
   

  

 The role combines strong technical capability (e.g. Python, SQL, data modelling) with a solid understanding of DB pensions data, ensuring that solutions are both technically robust and aligned to scheme requirements and member outcomes.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Design and deliver scalable data solutions, including data models, pipelines and tooling, translating business requirements into robust technical outputs using Python and SQL.
* Develop and automate data engineering processes, building efficient pipelines, optimising performance, and standardising reusable solutions across BPA schemes.
* Analyse and interpret DB pensions data, supporting data migration, mapping and transformation, and resolving complex data issues in line with scheme rules and calculations.
* Support transformation and change initiatives, collaborating with wider teams to enhance tooling, contribute to strategic data programmes, and embed best practice.
* Embed strong data quality, controls and governance, ensuring auditability, reconciliation, and alignment to regulatory and risk frameworks.
* Engage and collaborate with stakeholders, working across actuarial, operations and transition teams to deliver accurate, reliable and insight\-led data outputs.


**What are we looking for?**
* Proven experience in Python and SQL, with the ability to design, build and optimise data pipelines and data models.
* Strong experience working with DB pensions data (BPA) including data mapping, migration and transformation activities.
* Experience implementing data validation, reconciliation and control processes to ensure data quality and accuracy.

title: Director, Game Science & Insights
description:
#### **Who We Are**



Founded in 2005, 2K is a global video game company, publishing titles developed by some of the most influential game development studios in the world. Our studios — including Visual Concepts, Gearbox, Firaxis, Hangar 13, Cloud Chamber and HB Studios — develop 2K's portfolio of world\-class games across multiple platforms, spanning sports, shooters, action, role\-playing, strategy and more.



Our team of engineers, marketers, artists, writers, data scientists, producers, thinkers and doers are the professional publishing stewards of critically\-acclaimed franchises such as NBA 2K, Borderlands, Sid Meier's Civilization, BioShock, Mafia, WWE 2K, PGA 2K and XCOM. 2K is headquartered in Novato, California and is a wholly owned label of Take\-Two Interactive Software, Inc. (NASDAQ: TTWO).



At 2K, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment, which means encouraging our teams to Come as You Are and do your best work. We encourage all qualified applicants to explore our global positions.


#### **What We Need**



The Director, Game Science \& Insights is a senior technical leader within the Game Science \& Insights (GSI) organisation, reporting to the Senior Director, Game Science \& Insights. This role focuses on proactive problem solving through causal inference, experimentation, predictive modelling and AI integration. Our data scientists act as strategic partners, turning complex business challenges into testable hypotheses, validating them through causal inference or controlled experimentation, and then scaling the successful findings into predictive models and AI systems that help the business anticipate change and address challenges before they occur.



In this role you will lead and grow a multidisciplinary team of data scientists, data analysts and ML practitioners across our US, Ireland and UK hubs, using sophisticated player and commercial data to understand and influence engagement, retention and monetization across our AAA and live\-service franchises — directly shaping product decisions and business outcomes. The scope is significant: you will own analytical operations including recurring analysis, ad\-hoc insight, experimentation and the AI/ML systems that productionise our work.



This is a hands\-on, deeply technical leadership position. You are expected to be fluent in — and set the standard for — the modern data and AI stack we are deploying across the business today, and to keep 2K ahead of the curve as the technology landscape evolves**.**


#### **Our Technical Environment**



You will lead delivery on, and be highly proficient across, the platform and tooling we are actively deploying:


* Cloud data platforms: Snowflake and Databricks — data modelling, performance, governance at scale.
* Programming \& modelling: Python as the primary language for analysis, experimentation, statistical modelling and machine learning; production\-grade, well\-tested code.
* Analytics \& BI: Tableau/ Power BI for data storytelling, self\-service analytics and executive\-ready reporting.
* AI \& generative AI: Claude and other large language models applied to data science workflows, insight generation and internal tooling; broad fluency in modern AI/ML and GenAI techniques and how to apply them pragmatically and responsibly.
* AI\-assisted engineering: GitHub and GitHub AI (Copilot) for version control, code review and AI\-accelerated development across the team.
* SQL: expert\-level SQL underpinning all of the above.
* Project Management: Experience with project management and communication tools such as Asana, Confluence, JIRA, and Slack.

#### **What You Will Do**



Game Science \& Insights Strategy, Prioritisation and Execution


* Define the technical direction for the team — setting priorities and driving successful execution of analytics, experimentation and AI/ML projects across the product suite.
* Oversee the full AI/ML development lifecycle, from research and prototyping through to scalable deployment, monitoring and iteration on Snowflake and Databricks.
* Champion best practice in machine learning engineering, MLOps and cloud\-native development, embedding AI\-assisted tooling (Claude, GitHub AI) into how the team works.
* Direct experimentation and A/B testing initiatives, and apply causal inference to pinpoint winning strategies that boost conversion and long\-term player value with precision.
* Establish clear expectations for the effort required to deliver different types of analysis and data requests, manage bandwidth and bottlenecks, and ensure work progresses at quality and on time.
* Oversee the development of risk registers and contingency playbooks, particularly around game releases, and inform the development or licensing of key tools used by GSI.


Cross\-Functional Partnership and Execution


* Partner with product, commercial and marketing leaders to shape intelligent, player\-focused solutions grounded in evidence.
* Build strong partner relationships through honest, precise and consistent communication; evaluate, triage and prioritise incoming requests against team capacity.
* Transform intricate analytics into compelling, actionable guidance that empowers leadership — including the C\-suite — to lead with confidence.
* Amplify the 2k and central data strategy by engaging the right cross\-functional partners to build scalable, impactful solutions across the business.
* Communicate team plans, actions and outcomes across all levels of 2K and Take\-Two leadership.


Leadership and Team Building


* Lead, mentor and grow a multidisciplinary team of data scientists, data analysts and ML/software practitioners across Dublin and London, including individual contributors, team leads and managers.
* Delegate meaningful authority to technical leads and data science managers so individual teams execute with velocity and autonomy, while retaining effective day\-to\-day visibility.
* Detail specific guidelines and expectations for how each role can make the best impact, and foster a culture of innovation, ownership and continuous improvement.
* Take primary responsibility for recruiting within your organisation, and maintain a strong external network from which top talent can be drawn for strategic roles.
* Align team capacity to business needs when setting and adjusting FY OKRs, and proactively anticipate and address technical, managerial and procedural gaps (such as single points of failure) before they reach crisis level.
* Jump in to provide direct, hands\-on support when the team gets stuck or an all\-hands\-on\-deck data emergency arises.

#### **Who We Think Will Be a Great Fit**



The ideal candidate is, first and foremost, passionate about optimising great player experiences through data\-driven insight, experimentation and AI. They are a highly autonomous, technically credible leader who is consistently focused on sustainably increasing productivity and efficiency. They care deeply about their team and take strong ownership of each person's professional development.



They have the team seeking the 'Why' and 'So What' insights that move the needle, anticipate oncoming issues, and devise resourceful solutions. They are articulate and polished, and are ready to engage credibly with all levels of the organisation — from data scientists to the C\-suite. They also bring a proven understanding of live\-service games and how live services operate across genres today.


#### **Your Skills \& Experience**


* Experience in data science / advanced analytics, working with very large, sophisticated and multi\-dimensional data sets.
* People\-management experience, growing and developing teams of analysts and data scientists.
* Deep, hands\-on technical expertise across our stack: Snowflake, Databricks, Python, Tableau and expert SQL.
* Strong applied fluency in AI and machine learning, including the use of Claude / LLMs and GitHub AI (Copilot) to accelerate data science and engineering, applied pragmatically and responsibly.
* Strong command of user segmentation, targeting, A/B testing, controlled experimentation, causal inference and predictive modelling.
* Experience overseeing the AI/ML lifecycle end\-to\-end — research, prototyping, deployment, MLOps and monitoring.
* Experience identifying, communicating, managing and mitigating risk; comfortable managing ambiguity while solving ambitious problems.
* Excellent verbal and written communication, with the ability to translate complex analysis into clear guidance for technical and executive audiences.
* Proven track record contributing as part of a leadership team in a driven, fast\-paced, creative environment, and collaborating across numerous internal and external teams.
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Econometrics, Economics or a related field, or equivalent directly relevant industry experience; an advanced degree is a plus.

title: EMEA Data & Digital Program Manager
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. The EMEA Data Center Capacity Delivery (DCCD) team is seeking a highly motivated and technically skilled Business Intelligence Engineer / Data Scientist / AI Specialist to join our Business and Project Controls function. This is a pivotal role at the intersection of construction delivery, data engineering, and artificial intelligence \- supporting the EMEA DCCD team in transforming how we plan, monitor, and control the delivery of hyperscale data center capacity across the region.  

You will work closely with Construction Managers, Program Managers, Technical Infrastructure Program Managers (TIPMs), and regional leadership to design and deploy intelligent data solutions that provide real\-time visibility into project performance, cost, schedule, quality, and risk. You will be the data and AI engine behind our project controls function \- turning raw construction data into actionable insights that drive faster, smarter, and more consistent delivery decisions.  

This is an individual contributor role embedded within the EMEA DCCD Business and Project Controls team, reporting to the EMEA DCCD Business \& Project Controls Lead.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Business Intelligence \& Reporting  

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable, automated dashboards and reporting systems that provide real\-time visibility into EMEA DCCD project performance across cost, schedule, quality, and safety dimensions
* Build and maintain BI solutions using Amazon QuickSight, Power BI, or equivalent platforms, tailored to the needs of Construction Managers and senior leadership
* Develop leading indicator metrics and KPI frameworks that enable proactive risk identification and data\-driven decision\-making across the EMEA construction portfolio
* Serve as the primary liaison between the Business \& Project Controls function and technical data teams, ensuring reporting solutions are aligned to operational needs and business objectives
* Produce regular programme\-level performance reports and executive summaries, consolidating data from multiple projects and clusters across the EMEA region

  

Data Engineering \& ETL  

* Build and maintain robust ETL pipelines to ingest, transform, and integrate construction cost, schedule, and quality data from platforms including Procore, BIM 360, Smartsheet, and internal AWS data systems
* Design and manage data models and warehousing solutions that support automated reporting and longitudinal trend analysis across the EMEA portfolio
* Ensure data integrity, accuracy, and consistency across all reporting systems, establishing data governance standards and best practices within the project controls function
* Develop and maintain data pipelines using Python, SQL, and AWS services (S3, Lambda, Glue, Redshift, DynamoDB) to support scalable and repeatable analytics workflows


AI \& Machine Learning Solutions  

* Architect and deploy AI\-powered applications using Amazon Bedrock, LLMs, and GenAI capabilities to automate and enhance construction project controls processes, including:

o Predictive Schedule Analytics: ML models that identify schedule risk signals and forecast milestone slippage before it occurs  

o Cost Variance Intelligence: AI\-driven analysis of change orders, contingency consumption, and budget performance to surface anomalies and trends  

o Document Quality Automation: AI Vision and multimodal models to validate construction documentation, O\&M manuals, warranties, and as\-built drawings for completeness and compliance  

o Automated Reporting Narratives: LLM\-based generation of project status summaries and risk commentary from structured project data  

o Closeout Compliance Automation: Agentic workflows that validate handover documentation against commissioning checklists and contractual requirements  

* Build and operationalise machine learning models that extract insights from unstructured project documentation, enabling intelligent search, classification, and anomaly detection
* Integrate AI capabilities with existing construction technology platforms to create seamless, automated workflows that reduce manual effort and improve data quality

  

Project Controls Support  

* Support the Business \& Project Controls function in gathering, consolidating, and analysing data across EMEA clusters to produce accurate reporting on scope, schedule, budget, resources, quality, and risk
* Develop and maintain construction project control dashboards that integrate traditional project management metrics with AI\-generated predictive analytics
* Identify gaps in current reporting and process workflows; design and implement intelligent automation solutions to eliminate non\-value\-add activities and reduce level of effort (LOE) on repetitive tasks
* Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of project controls standards, templates, SOPs, and processes across the EMEA DCCD team

  

Stakeholder Engagement \& Change Management  

* Communicate complex data findings and AI\-generated insights clearly and concisely to both technical and non\-technical audiences, including senior leadership
* Drive adoption of new BI tools, AI solutions, and data\-driven workflows across the EMEA Construction team through training, documentation, and hands\-on support
* Collaborate with global counterparts in AMER and APJC to share best practices, align on data standards, and scale successful solutions across AWS's global construction portfolio
* Champion a culture of data\-driven decision\-making within the EMEA DCCD Business \& Project Controls function

  

A day in the life  

You will start your day reviewing automated project performance dashboards you have built, identifying any anomalies or risk signals that require attention. You will work with Construction Managers and TIPMs to understand their data needs and translate those needs into scalable reporting and AI solutions. You will spend time developing and refining ML models, building ETL pipelines, and deploying new AI\-powered features on Amazon Bedrock. You will present insights to programme leadership, using data to tell a clear story about where the portfolio stands and where risks are emerging. You will collaborate with peers across the global DCCD network to align on data standards and share solutions that can be scaled across regions.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience in technical product or program management
* Experience building and evaluating system\-level technical design
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or related STEM fields, or experience from a technical internship
* Knowledge of writing and optimizing SQL queries in a business environment with large\-scale, complex datasets
* Experience with reporting and Data Visualization tools such as Quick Sight / Tableau / Power BI or other BI packages
* Experience building data pipelines or automated ETL processes

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience with multimodal AI (AI Vision) for document validation, drawing compliance, or image\-based quality monitoring

 \- Design and develop metrics that measure Trust \& Safety enforcement across different products and content types.

 ​

Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy \- a mission we work towards every day.​
   

 We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
   

 ​
   

 Diversity \& Inclusion​

 Workday’s core value of integrity is the driving force behind the Workday Compliance \& Integrity Team, which provides all Workmates with the knowledge and tools needed to act with integrity in all business situations, including the development of innovative artificial intelligence (AI) products and services. Workday has been named one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies for five years, by Ethisphere, a global leader in defining and advancing the standards of ethical business practice. This is a purposeful, high visibility program with an ambitious agenda and executive support.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This is an exciting opportunity to assist with the growth and maturation of a still new but rapidly growing program at Workday, Responsible AI. In order to keep up with the accelerating demand to deliver advanced and innovative AI products and technologies to our customers, we must scale our ability to govern Workday’s development of AI technologies. The Responsible AI senior data scientist role is focused on developing the analytic capabilities needed to effectively translate and implement policies, guidelines, and standards set by the Responsible AI team. This includes contributing to the development of responsible AI evaluation capabilities, creating customer\-facing analysis reports and deliverables, and staying ahead of emerging methods, tools, and best practices in responsible AI (e.g., fairness, explainability, robustness, and observability) to anticipate future needs and risks and continuously advance our AI governance across evolving priority areas.
   

  

 This is a collaborative role as the Responsible AI team works closely with our ML engineers, product teams, and legal and privacy teams. The Responsible AI senior data scientist will be instrumental in providing the data\-driven insights necessary to guide the ethical and responsible development of Workday's AI technologies. * Define, implement, and document a curated set of metrics, evaluation templates, and best practices that teams can consistently adopt across diverse AI use cases, supporting scalable and repeatable Responsible AI governance.

* Produce clear, stakeholder\-facing analyses and narratives that explain evaluation approaches, findings, and tradeoffs, and act as an advocate for integrating Responsible AI considerations early and consistently in product and model development.

* Working knowledge of statistical analysis and hypothesis testing, including designing experiments and interpreting results.
* Hands\-on experience with modern ML and/or LLM tooling and platforms (e.g., Kubeflow, SageMaker, Databricks, or comparable tools), and familiarity with LLM observability and evaluation frameworks (e.g., LangSmith or similar).
* Demonstrated experience incorporating responsible AI practices into your work (e.g., fairness, transparency, ethics, and privacy considerations in AI systems).
* Experience working closely with cross\-functional partners such as product, technology/engineering, and legal or privacy teams.


**Other Qualifications**
* Familiarity with cloud services and architectures (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
* Familiarity with current and emerging AI policies, regulations, and guidelines such as NIST AI Risk Management Framework and EU AI Act

title: Director, Game Science & Insights
description:
****Who We Are****
 Founded in 2005, 2K is a global video game company, publishing titles developed by some of the most influential game development studios in the world. Our studios — including Visual Concepts, Gearbox, Firaxis, Hangar 13, Cloud Chamber and HB Studios — develop 2K’s portfolio of world\-class games across multiple platforms, spanning sports, shooters, action, role\-playing, strategy and more.
   

  

 Our team of engineers, marketers, artists, writers, data scientists, producers, thinkers and doers are the professional publishing stewards of critically\-acclaimed franchises such as NBA 2K, Borderlands, Sid Meier’s Civilization, BioShock, Mafia, WWE 2K, PGA 2K and XCOM. 2K is headquartered in Novato, California and is a wholly owned label of Take\-Two Interactive Software, Inc. (NASDAQ: TTWO).
   

  

 At 2K, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment, which means encouraging our teams to Come as You Are and do your best work. We encourage all qualified applicants to explore our global positions.
   

  

****What We Need****
 The Director, Game Science \& Insights is a senior technical leader within the Game Science \& Insights (GSI) organisation, reporting to the Senior Director, Game Science \& Insights. This role focuses on proactive problem solving through causal inference, experimentation, predictive modelling and AI integration. Our data scientists act as strategic partners, turning complex business challenges into testable hypotheses, validating them through causal inference or controlled experimentation, and then scaling the successful findings into predictive models and AI systems that help the business anticipate change and address challenges before they occur.
   

  

 In this role you will lead and grow a multidisciplinary team of data scientists, data analysts and ML practitioners across our US, Ireland and UK hubs, using sophisticated player and commercial data to understand and influence engagement, retention and monetization across our AAA and live\-service franchises — directly shaping product decisions and business outcomes. The scope is significant: you will own analytical operations including recurring analysis, ad\-hoc insight, experimentation and the AI/ML systems that productionise our work.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on, deeply technical leadership position. You are expected to be fluent in — and set the standard for — the modern data and AI stack we are deploying across the business today, and to keep 2K ahead of the curve as the technology landscape evolves
 **.**
****Our Technical Environment****
 You will lead delivery on, and be highly proficient across, the platform and tooling we are actively deploying:
   

  

* Cloud data platforms: Snowflake and Databricks — data modelling, performance, governance at scale.
* Programming \& modelling: Python as the primary language for analysis, experimentation, statistical modelling and machine learning; production\-grade, well\-tested code.
* Analytics \& BI: Tableau/ Power BI for data storytelling, self\-service analytics and executive\-ready reporting.
* AI \& generative AI: Claude and other large language models applied to data science workflows, insight generation and internal tooling; broad fluency in modern AI/ML and GenAI techniques and how to apply them pragmatically and responsibly.
* AI\-assisted engineering: GitHub and GitHub AI (Copilot) for version control, code review and AI\-accelerated development across the team.
* SQL: expert\-level SQL underpinning all of the above.
* Project Management: Experience with project management and communication tools such as Asana, Confluence, JIRA, and Slack.


****What You Will Do****
 Game Science \& Insights Strategy, Prioritisation and Execution
   

  

* Define the technical direction for the team — setting priorities and driving successful execution of analytics, experimentation and AI/ML projects across the product suite.
* Oversee the full AI/ML development lifecycle, from research and prototyping through to scalable deployment, monitoring and iteration on Snowflake and Databricks.
* Champion best practice in machine learning engineering, MLOps and cloud\-native development, embedding AI\-assisted tooling (Claude, GitHub AI) into how the team works.
* Direct experimentation and A/B testing initiatives, and apply causal inference to pinpoint winning strategies that boost conversion and long\-term player value with precision.
* Establish clear expectations for the effort required to deliver different types of analysis and data requests, manage bandwidth and bottlenecks, and ensure work progresses at quality and on time.
* Oversee the development of risk registers and contingency playbooks, particularly around game releases, and inform the development or licensing of key tools used by GSI.


 Cross\-Functional Partnership and Execution
   

  

* Partner with product, commercial and marketing leaders to shape intelligent, player\-focused solutions grounded in evidence.
* Build strong partner relationships through honest, precise and consistent communication; evaluate, triage and prioritise incoming requests against team capacity.
* Transform intricate analytics into compelling, actionable guidance that empowers leadership — including the C\-suite — to lead with confidence.
* Amplify the 2k and central data strategy by engaging the right cross\-functional partners to build scalable, impactful solutions across the business.
* Communicate team plans, actions and outcomes across all levels of 2K and Take\-Two leadership.


 Leadership and Team Building
   

  

* Lead, mentor and grow a multidisciplinary team of data scientists, data analysts and ML/software practitioners across Dublin and London, including individual contributors, team leads and managers.
* Delegate meaningful authority to technical leads and data science managers so individual teams execute with velocity and autonomy, while retaining effective day\-to\-day visibility.
* Detail specific guidelines and expectations for how each role can make the best impact, and foster a culture of innovation, ownership and continuous improvement.
* Take primary responsibility for recruiting within your organisation, and maintain a strong external network from which top talent can be drawn for strategic roles.
* Align team capacity to business needs when setting and adjusting FY OKRs, and proactively anticipate and address technical, managerial and procedural gaps (such as single points of failure) before they reach crisis level.
* Jump in to provide direct, hands\-on support when the team gets stuck or an all\-hands\-on\-deck data emergency arises.


****Who We Think Will Be a Great Fit****
 The ideal candidate is, first and foremost, passionate about optimising great player experiences through data\-driven insight, experimentation and AI. They are a highly autonomous, technically credible leader who is consistently focused on sustainably increasing productivity and efficiency. They care deeply about their team and take strong ownership of each person’s professional development.
   

  

 They have the team seeking the ‘Why’ and ‘So What’ insights that move the needle, anticipate oncoming issues, and devise resourceful solutions. They are articulate and polished, and are ready to engage credibly with all levels of the organisation — from data scientists to the C\-suite. They also bring a proven understanding of live\-service games and how live services operate across genres today.
   

  

**Your Skills \& Experience**
* Experience in data science / advanced analytics, working with very large, sophisticated and multi\-dimensional data sets.
* People\-management experience, growing and developing teams of analysts and data scientists.
* Deep, hands\-on technical expertise across our stack: Snowflake, Databricks, Python, Tableau and expert SQL.
* Strong applied fluency in AI and machine learning, including the use of Claude / LLMs and GitHub AI (Copilot) to accelerate data science and engineering, applied pragmatically and responsibly.
* Strong command of user segmentation, targeting, A/B testing, controlled experimentation, causal inference and predictive modelling.
* Experience overseeing the AI/ML lifecycle end\-to\-end — research, prototyping, deployment, MLOps and monitoring.
* Experience identifying, communicating, managing and mitigating risk; comfortable managing ambiguity while solving ambitious problems.
* Excellent verbal and written communication, with the ability to translate complex analysis into clear guidance for technical and executive audiences.
* Proven track record contributing as part of a leadership team in a driven, fast\-paced, creative environment, and collaborating across numerous internal and external teams.
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Econometrics, Economics or a related field, or equivalent directly relevant industry experience; an advanced degree is a plus.

 and do their best work.
   

  

**What We Need**
 2K is looking for a Sr. Applied Scientist to join the Applied AI Team in the Product Organization, with a focus on our flagship franchise NBA 2K. Our team leverages AI, machine learning, statistics, and operations research, and economics to build systems that power core game experiences. We develop algorithmic solutions in areas such as matchmaking, in\-game experience personalization, player engagement, in\-game economy, content optimization, and fraud detection.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Design, develop, and iterate on machine learning models that directly impact in\-game experiences and core systems (e.g., matchmaking, skill rating systems, recommender systems).
* Build and refine representation learning models to capture player skill, lineup/build strength, and interaction patterns from sequential gameplay data.
* Stay informed on state\-of\-the\-art techniques, evaluate their applicability, and lead efforts to integrate promising methods into our systems.
* Formulate ambiguous product problems into well\-defined machine learning tasks.
* Lead technical discussions, advocate for best practices in model development and deployment, and ensure scientific rigor.
* Collaborate closely with engineers, MLEs, and product stakeholders to integrate models into production systems and influence game design decisions.


**What Will Make You A Great Fit**
 We are seeking a senior scientist with strong foundations in machine learning and statistics, combined with hands\-on experience building and applying models to real\-world problems. The ideal candidate is comfortable working with imperfect data, defining problems from scratch, and applying modern modeling approaches—including deep learning and representation learning—to generate meaningful impact.
   

  

 They should be a curious, solution\-oriented problem solver who can move between research ideas and practical implementation, and who takes ownership of their work end\-to\-end.

title: Principal Decision Scientist - Marketing
description:

We have grown from a five\-person team to a truly international company of over 850\+ people, representing more than 50 nationalities, with ten offices distributed across Europe and the US. In 2020, Pipedrive received a majority investment from Vista Equity Partners, a global investment firm that invests exclusively in enterprise software, data and technology\-enabled businesses, making Pipedrive the fifth unicorn from Estonia.
   

  

 As a Principal Decision Scientist \- Marketing, you will lead the development of an analytics function that transforms complex, cross\-channel data into strategic insights and measurable business impact. You’ll shape the technical direction for advanced analytics initiatives, driving sophisticated modelling, experimentation, and data infrastructure capabilities that support smarter decision\-making across the organization. Operating at the intersection of data science, marketing, and business strategy, you will translate large\-scale datasets into actionable recommendations that optimize performance, improve customer outcomes, and support commercial growth. Partnering closely with Marketing, Product, Finance, and Data teams, you will establish scalable measurement frameworks, promote analytical best practices, and influence key business decisions. * Proven, hands\-on experience building and deploying Marketing Mix Models (MMM) and incrementality testing frameworks (geo\-based, holdout, synthetic control) in a real business context
* Proficiency in applied statistical modelling, such as LTV modeling, predictive scoring and causal inference techniques
* Advanced Python or R for statistical analysis, modelling, and automation, with production\-quality code standards
* Practical experience applying AI tools to accelerate, enhance and automate analytical workflows
* Demonstrated experience architecting scalable data models using SQL and dbt within a modern data stack, including setting standards and reviewing others' work
* Exceptional ability to distil complex technical findings into clear strategic narratives for non\-technical stakeholders and senior leadership
* Experience working within a high\-growth SaaS or digital business with an understanding of unit economics (CAC, LTV, Payback)
* Demonstrated experience mentoring and developing analysts including coaching on technical skills, analytical thinking and stakeholder engagement
* Exposure to product analytics or growth functions, with an ability to connect marketing and product data across the funnel
* Prior experience influencing tooling, vendor or data infrastructure decisions at an organisational level


**Why Pipedrive?**
* People\-first culture \- Be part of a team that values authenticity, champions collaboration, and supports each other—no egos, just teamwork. Work alongside top talent from around the world in an inclusive space where different perspectives fuel our best ideas. Everyone is welcome
* Unlock potential – Push boundaries, take ownership, and experiment with the latest technologies as we enhance our AI First Vision. We empower bold ideas that drive real change
* We’ve got you – Your well\-being matters. Enjoy flexible hours, wellness perks and SWAG. Think performance\-based bonuses, 28 paid leave days, well\-being days, compassionate leave, and even paternal leave—because we take care of ourselves and our people
* Grow with us – Whether through mentorship, coaching, or internal mobility, we invest in helping you unlock your potential. Open, honest feedback and clear communication are at our core. We grow together through trust and accountability
* Packed with purpose – Help 100,000\+ small and medium\-sized businesses grow and succeed while doing meaningful, customer\-driven work


**Diversity \& Inclusion:** 
 Pipedrive is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications regardless of race, color, religion, age, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, veteran status, marital or family status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
   

  

**Eligibility:** 
 Please note that for this position, we are only able to consider candidates who already possess the legal right to work in Ireland without the need for visa sponsorship or relocation assistance.
   

  

**Background Checks:** 
 Where permitted by local law and necessitated by the scope of the role (e.g., access to sensitive data), Pipedrive may conduct a pre\-employment background check. This will be handled in strict accordance with our Candidates Privacy Notice.

title: Data Reliability Engineer
description:
**Overview**
 Susquehanna is a global quantitative trading firm powered by scientific rigor, curiosity, and innovation. Our culture is intellectually driven and highly collaborative, bringing together researchers, engineers, and traders to design and deploy impactful strategies in our systematic trading environment. To meet the unique challenges of global markets, Susquehanna applies machine learning and advanced quantitative research to vast datasets in order to uncover actionable insights and build effective strategies. By uniting deep market expertise with cutting\-edge technology, we excel in solving complex problems and pushing boundaries together.
   

  

 We're looking for a Data Reliability Engineer to keep our trading and data platforms running seamlessly. You'll be a guardian of the Python data pipelines and the scheduled start\- and end\-of\-day jobs our trading desks depend on, making sure these trading\-critical workflows run on time and with precision. In equal measure you'll work hands\-on with the data: onboarding new datasets, reconciling and validating them, and tracing anomalies back to their source. When something breaks you'll dive in, diagnose quickly, and make the fix that keeps downstream systems healthy.
   

  

 You'll work across a layered platform: an ingestion layer that decodes incoming feeds into structured data, a data\-flow framework that streams and transforms it, configuration\-driven feeds and analytical applications built on top, scheduled batch jobs that assemble each day's start\- and end\-of\-day datasets, and a serving layer that delivers it all to trading tools. Across every layer you'll work alongside quantitative researchers, developers, and traders, as well as other reliability engineers on the team and partner teams such as those in reference and market data, to review changes, manage releases, and continually strengthen both the pipelines and the data flowing through them.
   

  

**In This Role You Will**
* Engineer Build and maintain the tooling that brings new data sources onto the platform, turning ad\-hoc data handling into dependable, automated workflows in Python.
* Analyse Get to know the data inside out, validate and reconcile it against expectations, and help researchers get it into the shape their models need.
* Investigate When a derived dataset looks wrong, chase the discrepancy upstream until you find the root cause, combining detective work, technical analysis, and the right conversations across teams.
* Support Provide proactive oversight of trading\-critical scheduled jobs and Python pipelines, keeping them on time and within SLA; triage, troubleshoot, and resolve incidents under tight turnaround, validating downstream impact and keeping recovery procedures ready.
* Release Own safe delivery to production \- review configuration and code changes, enforce safe deployment standards, and coordinate risk\-aware releases through GitLab and Octopus Deploy.


**What We're Looking For**
* 2\+ years in a data engineering, data science, or production\-support role, or a degree in a technical or data discipline.
* Demonstrated experience with Python (or a comparable language).
* Experience with at least one SQL variant (PostgreSQL, MSSQL, MySQL), and the ability to pick up others as needed.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills; detail\-oriented, self\-motivated, and curious.
* Willingness to work shifts: the team works an alternating weekday early/late shift rotation, with participation in an on\-call rota.
* Exposure to change\-management and incident\-management practices.
* Comfort with technical documentation and handling support cases.
* Comfortable working in both Windows and Linux environments.

title: Cost Intelligence Analyst
description:
**This role can be based in any Uisce Éireann office nationwide.** 




  





 We are Uisce Éireann. Every day, we are responsible for the delivery of secure, safe, and sustainable water services for the people of Ireland. As Ireland’s national regulated water utility, our vision is a sustainable Ireland where water is respected and protected, for the planet and all the lives it supports.
 



  





 Our purpose at Uisce Éireann is to rise to the challenge of delivering transformative water services that enable communities to thrive. That means we are proud to take on the responsibility of protecting our water supply and passing on a safe and secure water system to a rapidly growing population and empowering Ireland’s social and economic growth.
 



  





 We are passionate about empowering our people, enabling them to make a positive impact on communities across Ireland. We are guided by a shared vision and purpose, grounded in values that define who we are and shape how we work, where we deliver for customers and communities, we work better together, we do the right thing, we aim high, and we keep each other safe. Our behaviours define how we interact, communicate, and succeed together. These values and behaviours apply to each one of us, across every role, location, and level.
 



  





 Our goal is to attract and develop skilled and talented people from diverse backgrounds, who bring a dynamic range of expertise and insights to our work. With a strong, values\-driven workforce, we ensure Uisce Éireann can continue advancing Ireland’s water services and meeting the needs of the communities we serve for generations to come.
 



  





**The Role:** 




 The Commercial Function within the Infrastructure Delivery Directorate is responsible for providing the Directorate with the expert commercial and contract management knowledge that is required to deliver the Capital Investment Plan. As the commercial center of excellence driving consistency in the commercial management of contractual arrangements, this team works to minimise risk and increase efficiency in the delivery of the CIP.
 



  





 They are responsible for building commercial competence and capability within the directorate, increasing and evidencing value, whilst reducing commercial, quality and supervisory risk from the way in which the portfolio is delivered. There are three core departments within the Commercial Function, namely Commercial \& Contract Management, Estimation and Cost Intelligence and Construction Services.
 



  





 The Estimation and Cost Intelligence Team are responsible for enhancing the understanding of our costs and being able to predict when and why cost changes occur, and what actions may be taken to mitigate these, if any. This team will be responsible for the provision of estimates as required throughout the project life cycle and for maintaining the systems that underpin the production of these estimates. This team will have a range of interfaces within the IDD function, and beyond, working closely with Asset Management, Finance and Regulation to ensure that accurate and reliable forecasts are prepared to underpin investment plans and revenue control periods. In addition, this team will be required to keep estimating methodologies under constant review to ensure that the most appropriate and robust processes are incorporated into our estimating practices to provide confidence and credibility to project estimates.
 



  





 Reporting to the Cost Intelligence Technical Lead, the Cost Intelligence Analyst will be part of a cost intelligence team that is responsible for maintaining contemporaneous and accurate cost intelligence data that is used to underpin the estimates that are prepared for projects and programmes across the Infrastructure Delivery Directorate. the Cost Intelligence Analyst will be responsible for supporting cost estimating and development of costing estimating strategies and tools to assist investment planning and asset management.
 



  





 The Cost Intelligence Analyst will contribute into the maintenance of Uisce Éireann’s Unit Cost Database and Project Costing Tool and be responsible for ensuring accuracy of the cost data within Uisce Éireann datasets. They will also assist in the validating of costs relating to capital efficiencies as proposed by Infrastructure Delivery.
 



  





**Main Duties and Responsibilities:** 



* Support the Cost Intelligence team in the establishment of Uisce Éireann‘s costing approach and implement the strategies to underpin the Capital Investment Plan.
* Work with stakeholders to ensure accurate data is input into the Unit Cost Database and Project Costing Template and work with stakeholders to improve processes.
* Data analysis and production of cost models; and to facilitate the incorporation of models into estimating tools.
* Undertake analysis to provide management information on Uisce Éireann’s costs, to be used in highlighting trends, risks and opportunities for efficiency.
* Data management \& governance in the collation of information for the cost basis for proposed capital efficiency savings.
* Participating in the delivery of initiatives to support the development of UÉs cost intelligence capability.
* Support the development of cost information alignment strategy to enable consistent cost categorisation.
* Support the implementation of the costing strategy and benchmarking policy.
* Assisting in co\-ordinating the activities of external service providers.
* Implementing cost database enhancements are aligned to future investment planning requirements.
* Developing Key Performance Indicators in relation to cost estimation completed both internally and externally through service providers.
* Raise risks and issues as appropriate to the Cost Intelligence Specialist

title: Researcher / Research Scholar - BeWhere model

description:
The AFE Research Group focuses on generating new scientific knowledge and developing state‑of‑the‑art modeling tools to support the understanding, assessment, and management of global and regional agriculture, forestry, and natural land systems under increasing uncertainty. The group’s research aims to inform policy and decision‑making related to sustainable land use, resource management, and climate mitigation.
 



  





 Robust assessment and management of natural resources require a deep understanding of complex, interacting biophysical and techno‑economic processes within terrestrial ecosystems. To this end, AFE seeks to advance integrated analytical approaches that jointly address agriculture, forestry, and natural land ecosystems at global, regional, and national scales. The group’s ambition is to maintain a leading position in interdisciplinary research that bridges natural resource systems, energy systems, and sustainability transitions.
 



  





**The Role** 




  





**BeWhere** 
 is a mature, spatially explicit supply\-chain optimization model for planning low\- and negative\-carbon technology systems across national, regional, and global scales. It supports the siting, sizing, interconnection, conversion, transport, storage, and use of resources and products including electricity, water, biomass, bioenergy, advanced biofuels, biomaterials, hydrogen, e\-fuels, carbon dioxide, and long\-lived wood\-based products. The holistic framework of BeWhere supports the assessment of carbon dioxide removal and carbon\-management pathways, including decarbonization and de\-fossilization of ‘hard\-to\-abate’ sectors, BECCS, DACS, biogenic CO₂ utilization, CO2 and H2 transportation, and CCUS value chains.
 



  





 The AFE Research Group seeks a scientifically driven researcher (soon\-to\-be PhD or experienced) to support the continued development and application of BeWhere in cutting\-edge EU Horizon projects on circular bioeconomy planning under diverse ecosystem\-service constraints; integrating land\-sea biomass; renewable\-energy expansion; and supply\-chain optimization for energy and material including CO2 and H2 based advance value chains. The successful candidate will help integrate heterogeneous spatial datasets, prepare BeWhere\-ready model inputs, support scenario runs, analyze optimization outputs, and develop interactive visualization tools. The role will also support the further expansion of BeWhere’s capabilities in the co\-optimization of multi\-sectoral energy systems, multi\-objective optimization, uncertainty\-aware and stochastic modelling approaches, and advanced statistical analysis, contributing to its development as a supply\-chain, and material\-energy system modelling platform
 



  





**Main Tasks \& Responsibilities** 




  




* Enhance and maintain the BeWhere model database by integrating spatial data sets relevant to the circular bioeconomy including techno‑economic, socio‑economic, ecosystem services, and policy‑related information.
* Expand BeWhere’s capabilities to include multi\-objective optimization, uncertainty\-aware and stochastic modelling approaches. Analyze, interpret and visualize BeWhere modelling results by producing spatial maps, indicators, and visualization tools to communicate result for scientific publications, project deliverables, and stakeholder engagement.
* In line with the collaborative and interdisciplinary working culture at IIASA, the incumbent may occasionally contribute to additional tasks assigned by supervisors. These may fall outside the immediate scope of this position but will draw on the post holder’s expertise and support the group’s work where emerging needs or temporary capacity constraints arise



  





**Skills, Qualifications \& Experience** 




  





**Education and Background** 



* Ideally a completed PhD, OR candidates in the final year of their PhD, combined with relevant experience and demonstrated expertise in engineering, energy or power systems, or bioenergy, biotechnologies, industrial energy systems or a closely related field.



  





**Essential skills and competencies:** 



* Proven experience with mathematical energy system optimization models; techno\-economic modelling or life cycle analysis.
* Demonstrated experience in GAMS, Python, Julia for optimization and Python or R for scientific data processing.
* Experience with GIS and spatial data analysis.
* Full fluency in English, both written and spoken.
* Ability to work well as part of a team and independently.



  





**Desirable skills:** 



* Experience in Energy System Modelling, or Supply chain Optimization
* Understanding of AI/ML, SysML, Model‑Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) approaches is a plus
* Understanding of biophysical aspects of ecosystems, and land\-use change including forestry, agriculture, and aquaculture systems.
* Familiarity with scenario analysis, AI/ML based foresight methods, and infrastructure or supply‑chain planning.
* Knowledge of decision‑making under uncertainty, including stochastic modeling, risk assessment, and security or safety research.
* Experience with spatial analysis and Geographic Information Systems (GIS).
* Experience in project management, including the preparation of technical and scientific reports.
* Working knowledge to develop interactive web‑based interfaces for model communication.



  





**Appointment Terms**

 **as soon as possible** 
 .
 



 The place of work is IIASA in Laxenburg, near Vienna, Austria (home office options available).

 Bei uns zählt, was du einbringst \- fachlich und persönlich. Wir vertrauen auf Eigenverantwortung und schaffen Rahmenbedingungen, die dir Gestaltungsspielraum geben. So kannst du deine Energie dort einsetzen, wo sie am meisten wirkt.
   

  

 Diversity \& Miteinander
   

  

 Vielfalt gehört bei uns zum Alltag. Unterschiedliche Identitäten, Perspektiven und Lebenswege bereichern unsere Zusammenarbeit und unser Miteinander. Mit internen Netzwerken, Aktionstagen, Trainings und Formaten wie dem Diversity Talk machen wir diese Vielfalt sichtbar und erlebbar. Unsere Diversity Charta bringt auf den Punkt, was wir leben.
   

  

 Events und Aktivitäten
   

  

 Erfolge feiern wir gemeinsam, genauso wie das Miteinander. Ob Wien Energie Business Run, Sommerfest oder Weihnachtsfeier: Unsere Events bringen das \#TeamWienEnergie zusammen, schaffen Verbindung und machen erlebbar, was uns auszeichnet.
   

  

 Flexibilität im Alltag
   

  

 Deine Energie entfaltet sich dann am besten, wenn du selbst mitgestalten kannst. Ob im Büro, im Außendienst oder in technischen Bereichen – wir bieten flexible Arbeitszeiten und eine 37,5\-Stunden\-Woche. Unsere planbaren Schichtmodelle sorgen für eine verlässliche Arbeitsplanung. Außerdem ermöglichen wir Job\-Sharing, auch in Führungspositionen. So schaffen wir Raum für ein Arbeitsleben, das zu dir passt.
   

  

 Gesundes Essen
   

  

 Wer Energie gibt, braucht auch Energie zurück. In unserer Betriebsküche gibt es täglich frische Auswahl \- leistbar, ausgewogen und nah am Alltag. Obstkörbe und Getränke sorgen für kleine Pausen zwischendurch.
   

  

 Gesundheit
   

  

 Damit du deine Energie für Wiens Energie einbringen kannst, braucht es auch Raum für dich. Mit Angeboten rund um Bewegung, mentale Gesundheit, Prävention und Balance unterstützen wir dich dabei, gut durch den Alltag zu kommen und langfristig gesund zu bleiben.
   

  

 Im Team verbunden
   

  

 Wir arbeiten miteinander abteilungs\- und standortübergreifend. Im \#TeamWienEnergie unterstützen wir uns, denken bereichsübergreifend und feiern auch gemeinsame Erfolge. Wir erreichen mehr, wenn wir verbunden bleiben.
   

  

 Innovationen \& Zusammenarbeit
   

  

 Neue Ideen brauchen Raum und Menschen, die sie einbringen. In Kooperation mit Hochschulen, Start\-ups und im Team entwickeln wir Lösungen, die Wien nachhaltig bewegen. Deine Energie zählt dabei genauso wie dein Blick über den Tellerrand.
   

  

 Jobticket
   

  

 Was wir für Wien tun, beginnt bei uns selbst: Mit dem kostenlosen Jahresticket der Wiener Linien oder einer Förderung für andere Öffis bist du das ganze Jahr klimafreundlich unterwegs und Teil der Mobilitätswende, die wir gemeinsam mitgestalten.
   

  

 Lebensphasen \& Auszeiten
   

  

 Manchmal braucht das Leben mehr Raum und den geben wir, wo es möglich ist. Ob Karenz, Pflegefreistellung oder Auszeiten: Wir finden gemeinsam Lösungen, wenn sich berufliche und private Anforderungen verändern. Mit Angeboten wie heycare unterstützen wir dich auch ganz konkret im Alltag, wie etwa bei der Betreuung von Kindern, älteren Angehörigen oder Haustieren.
   

  

 Lernen \& Wachsen
   

  

 Du wirst vom ersten Tag an gut begleitet. Ob Onboarding, Fachtrainings, Persönlichkeitsentwicklung oder individuelle Karrierepfade: Wir fördern dein Können und deine Energie auf dem Weg, der zu dir passt.
   

  

 Mentoring \& Wissensaustausch
   

  

 Bei uns lernst du nicht nur in Trainings, sondern von und mit Kolleg\*innen: durch strukturierte Mentoring\-Programme (auch konzernweit), Erfahrungsaustausch und Formate, in denen Wissen geteilt und weitergegeben wird.
   

  

 Sinnstiftende Arbeit
   

  

 Unsere Arbeit hat Wirkung: heute und für kommende Generationen. Mit deiner Energie leistest du einen Beitrag zur klimafreundlichen Energiezukunft und zur Lebensqualität in unserer Stadt.
   

  

 „Meine Energie für Wiens Energie“ bringt auf den Punkt, was uns verbindet, ganz gleich, in welcher Rolle du bei uns wirkst.
   

  

 Vergünstigungen \& Vorsorge
   

  

 Als Teil unseres \#TeamWienEnergie profitierst du von Angeboten, die deinen Alltag bereichern \- von Sport und Kultur bis zu attraktiven Konditionen bei Partner\*innenunternehmen in und rund um Wien.
